description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayDiscovery UI components and the GatewayDiscoveryModel within an iOS/macOS Swift project. It defines a test suite with several test functions that instantiate models and views, verifying their UI-building logic.

classes.name: MasterDiscoveryMenuSmokeTests
classes.description: A suite of UI tests for GatewayDiscovery-related views and models, verifying that their 'body' properties build UI correctly under various states.

methods.name: `inline list builds body when empty`
methods.description: Tests that the GatewayDiscoveryInlineList view correctly builds its body when the gateways list is empty.

methods.name: `inline list builds body with master and selection`
methods.description: Tests that the GatewayDiscoveryInlineList view correctly displays when there is a single gateway and a current target.

methods.name: `menu builds body with masters`
methods.description: Tests that the GatewayDiscoveryMenu view correctly builds its UI when multiple gateways are discovered.
